title: Binary vector encoding in an adjoining-root algebra
statement: For binary vectors $m,a\in\mathbb{F}_2^\ell$, let $f_m(X)=X^\ell+\sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1}m_iX^i$. The encoding of $a$ in the algebra obtained by adjoining a root of $f_m$ is the class of $\sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1}a_iX^i$ modulo the relation $f_m(X)=0$.
